depth_frame.note: matmuls 56-68 % DRAM; nlp_create_qkv_heads + nlp_concat_heads 4.2 ms on 2 cores

dit_step.note: compute-bound; fp16 accumulation + full-grid configs + fused SiLU + 256-wide SDPA

named_limitations: tt_transformers decode matmuls are DRAM-sharded on 12 cores (one per bank); this tt-metal build has no num_workers_per_dram_bank, LoFi is what makes them bandwidth-bound
ttnn.topk over a non-power-of-two 16416-wide window costs 5 ms and ttnn.gather 5 ms; a 1 MB read-back costs 0.18 ms, so CFG/top-k stay on the host
nlp_create_qkv_heads / nlp_concat_heads parallelise over tile rows: 2 cores for the depth decoder's 2 x 32 rows (4.2 ms per frame)
fp32 destination accumulation halves the matmul subblock capacity; the DiT runs fp16 accumulation (log-mel 0.98 -> 1.27 dB with in0_block_w 4)

ttnn.experimental.conv3d in fp32 with the default 1D blocking runs the 31 vocoder convs in 16 s per window (host: 7.3 s); bf16 conv3d exceeds L1; tt_dit padding helpers write host tensors inside the graph so the vocoder cannot be traced
bf16 MLP weights do not fit the prefill MLP matmul's circular buffers on P150 (1.82 MB > 1.5 MB)
